dominant_strengths: Confident bold headline typography paired with a soft pastel gradient creates a clear, friendly hero focal point.
Cute zigzag torn-paper edges and the pill CTA show genuine craft and personality beyond default marketing chrome.
Sidebar mockup conveys product concept quickly with recognizable app icons and clean Mac window chrome.
dominant_weaknesses: Saturated cobalt blue header clashes tonally with the airy pastel hero, fracturing color harmony into two unrelated zones.
Nav spacing is uneven and the tiny iOS/atom glyphs beside Mobile/Max feel decorative noise rather than meaningful affordances.
Blurred placeholder text in the browser mockup reads as unfinished rather than intentional, weakening reflective trust.
fix_priorities: Reconcile palette: tone down the blue or carry a pastel accent into the header for cross-section continuity.
Tighten nav rhythm and remove or clarify the inline icons next to Max and Mobile labels.
Replace blurred mock content with real, legible UI copy to communicate product value with confidence.
Add subtle motion or hover states cue to the Try Dia CTA to elevate visceral pull.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral pastel charm is decent but behavioral clarity and reflective payoff lag because the mockup obscures actual product behavior.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a Dia/Arc marketing landing page rather than the Arc Mac app itself, only partially matching the stated brief.
